en_title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered Update Patch Notes Include PC-Specific and Console-Specific Changes
cn_title: 《巫师3》重制版更新详列各平台改动
subtitle: 配置要求也变了
opus_summary: CD Projekt公布《巫师3：狂猎》重制版详细更新说明，列出PC与主机平台各自的改动。游戏将于9月29日推出，已购买任意版本的玩家可在同一平台生态内免费升级，系统配置要求也已调整。

paragraphs.en: CD Projekt has released the patch notes for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered update, confirming PC and console-specific changes to the single-player role-playing game.
paragraphs.cn: CD Projekt公布了《巫师3：狂猎》重制版的更新说明，确认这款单人角色扮演游戏在PC和主机平台上各有不同改动。

paragraphs.en: Adding to its official list of improvements for The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered , CD Projekt has now released detailed patch notes that anyone downloading the update tomorrow will find interesting, as published on The Witcher website .
paragraphs.cn: 除了此前公布的《巫师3：狂猎》重制版改进清单，CD Projekt如今又在《巫师》官网发布了详细更新说明。准备明天下载更新的玩家可以看看。

paragraphs.en: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered releases September 29 on PC (Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, Battle.net), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. If you bought any version of the game in the past, physical or digital, you can upgrade for free to the Remastered version within the same platform ecosystem as soon as it releases. (We’ve got the official The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered global release times , so you know when the game unlocks in your region, as well as the update download sizes so you can prepare.)
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3：狂猎》重制版将于9月29日登陆PC（Steam、GOG、Epic Games Store、Battle.net）、PS5、XBOX Series和任天堂Switch 2。此前购买过任意实体版或数字版的玩家，可在重制版推出后，于同一平台生态内免费升级。（官方已公布《巫师3：狂猎》重制版的全球解锁时间和更新下载大小，玩家可以据此确认所在地区的解锁时间并提前准备。）

paragraphs.en: To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the Things the Witcher 3 Doesn’t Tell You , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 Walkthrough and The Witcher 3 Endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 Sex and Romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher Gear Locations , Places of Power Locations , and even Gwent Card Locations .
paragraphs.cn: 想更快适应杰洛特的旅途，可以看看《巫师3》中游戏没告诉你的事，以及IGN的《巫师3》流程攻略和结局指南；后两者梳理了本体与资料片中的所有主要任务和选择，资料片现已包含在重制版中。等你准备好面对棘手抉择，还可以查看我们的《巫师3》恋爱指南，了解杰洛特能与谁亲吻，以及有哪些机会。若想让杰洛特尽可能成为强大的猎魔人，也可以查看猎魔人装备、魔力之所，甚至昆特牌的位置指南。
